# NeonPine – MCU netlist for firmware

*Generated by `tools/mcu_netlist.py` from `NeonPine.kicad_sch` – do not edit by hand, rerun the script after pin changes.*

MCU: **U1 CH32V003F4P6** (TSSOP-20), **VDD = 5 V**, HSI ×2 = 48 MHz (needed by rv003usb).

## U1 pins

| Pin | Port | Net | Firmware use | Connects to |

| 2 | PD5 | SR_LATCH | 74HC595 RCLK (U2, U3): rising edge copies the shift registers to the outputs | U2.12; U3.12 |
| 3 | PD6 | GATE_DRV | Boost MOSFET gate (via R1 47R, R2 100k pull-down): **TIM2_CH3, AFIO TIM2_RM = 11** (full remap), ≈30 kHz, ≤60 % duty | R1 47 → **GATE**: Q1.1, R2.1 (100k) |

## 74HC595 chain (U2 → U3)

`SR_DATA` → U2 SER, U2 QH′ → U3 SER (`SR_CHAIN`); clock and latch are shared. /OE is tied low and /SRCLR high, so the outputs
are random until the first latch (the boost is held off by R2 meanwhile). Shift a 16-bit word **MSB first**
(`SR_DATA` valid before the `SR_CLK` rising edge), then pulse `SR_LATCH`. Word bit *b* ends up on:

| Word bit | Output | Pin | Net | Drives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | U3 QH | 7 | LAMPA6 | LA6 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q16 unit B via R56 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 14 | U3 QG | 6 | – | – (not connected) |
| 13 | U3 QF | 5 | LAMPA9 | LA9 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q19 unit B via R59 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 12 | U3 QE | 4 | LAMP10 | LA10 K side: lamp pad 1 switch (Q20 unit A via R50 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 11 | U3 QD | 3 | LAMPA10 | LA10 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q20 unit B via R60 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 10 | U3 QC | 2 | – | – (not connected) |
| 9 | U3 QB | 1 | – | – (not connected) |
| 8 | U3 QA | 15 | – | – (not connected) |
| 7 | U2 QH | 7 | LAMPA3 | LA3 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q13 unit B via R53 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 6 | U2 QG | 6 | LAMPA5 | LA5 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q15 unit B via R55 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 5 | U2 QF | 5 | LAMP1 | LA1 K side: lamp pad 1 switch (Q11 unit A via R41 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 4 | U2 QE | 4 | LAMPA1 | LA1 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q11 unit B via R51 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 3 | U2 QD | 3 | LAMPA2 | LA2 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q12 unit B via R52 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 2 | U2 QC | 2 | LAMPA4 | LA4 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q14 unit B via R54 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 1 | U2 QB | 1 | LAMPA7 | LA7 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q17 unit B via R57 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |
| 0 | U2 QA | 15 | LAMPA8 | LA8 A side: lamp pad 2 switch (Q18 unit B via R58 22k); high = on = that electrode glows |

## Lamps

Each lamp sits in an H-bridge (DESIGN.md §2.3): turning the **K-side** switch on makes lamp pad 1 the cathode (that electrode glows),
the **A-side** switch makes pad 2 the cathode. Never turn both on (dark, but both 150k pull-ups draw current).

| Lamp | K side (net LAMPn) | A side (net LAMPAn) |
|---|---|---|
| LA1 | U2 QF = **SR bit 5** | U2 QE = **SR bit 4** |
| LA2 | U1 pin 12 = **PC2** | U2 QD = **SR bit 3** |
| LA3 | U1 pin 14 = **PC4** | U2 QH = **SR bit 7** |
| LA4 | U1 pin 11 = **PC1** | U2 QC = **SR bit 2** |
| LA5 | U1 pin 13 = **PC3** | U2 QG = **SR bit 6** |
| LA6 | U1 pin 16 = **PC6** | U3 QH = **SR bit 15** |
| LA7 | U1 pin 10 = **PC0** | U2 QB = **SR bit 1** |
| LA8 | U1 pin 8 = **PD0** | U2 QA = **SR bit 0** |
| LA9 | U1 pin 15 = **PC5** | U3 QF = **SR bit 13** |
| LA10 | U3 QE = **SR bit 12** | U3 QD = **SR bit 11** |

## Peripheral / option-byte summary

* **Option bytes:** NRST disabled (RST_MODE = GPIO) – PD7 carries SR_DATA. Keep it disabled if the rv003usb bootloader is
  configured (its `configurebootloader` sets OB_RST_EN_DT1ms by default).
* **AFIO:** TIM2_RM = 11 (TIM2_CH3 → PD6). The other TIM2 channels then map to PC1/PC7/PD5 – leave their outputs disabled.
* **Timers:** TIM2 = boost PWM (CH3). TIM1 and SysTick are free (BAM frame, UI timing).
* **ADC:** A0 = PA2 touch, A1 = PA1 light sensor, A4 = PD3 HV feedback (calibrate against Vrefint).
* **USB (rv003usb `usb_config.h`):** `USB_PORT D`, `USB_PIN_DP 2`, `USB_PIN_DM 4`, no `USB_PIN_DPU` (R15 1k5 pulls D− to
  VBUS permanently; force re-enumeration by driving D− low briefly). EXTI line 4 is taken; its handler must be the highest
  priority and never be preempted – keep other ISRs short or preemptible.
* **Reset state:** all pins are floating inputs. R2 holds the boost gate low, so HV+ stays at ≈ 5 V and the lamp switches
  (floating bases, no pull-downs) cannot light anything; drive the lamp pins and latch the 595s before starting TIM2.
